name: Reaper::shutdown_all (deadlines)

test_list.description: A resource that hangs in both the graceful and the forced step is reported Abandoned after graceful + forced virtual time; resources before and after it are Released.
A resource that misses the graceful deadline but succeeds when forced is reported Forced.
An error (not a hang) in the graceful step is reported Failed and force is never attempted.
When the overall budget runs out, the current step is cut short (Abandoned) and untouched resources are Skipped; deadline_exceeded is set and elapsed equals the overall deadline.
A real tokio task that ignores its token is aborted by the forced step and reported Forced.
Abandoned and skipped resources remain listed as leaked after shutdown.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: graceful and forced per-step deadlines and the overall deadline.

output_description: Outcome per resource (Released, Forced, Failed, Abandoned, Skipped), elapsed time and deadline_exceeded.
